_hostname: The address to put on the QR code and under 'On your phone'. Leave it out and the board uses its Wi-Fi address, which only works at home. Set it to the name a VPN such as Tailscale gives the Pi and the link keeps working anywhere.
_google: Two-way sync. Make a Google Cloud project, turn on the Calendar API, and create an OAuth client of type 'Desktop app'. Then connect the account from the board's own screen: Calendar app → Connect Google Calendar.
_lights: Optional. The Lights widget talks to Zigbee2MQTT through Mosquitto, which pi/install.sh sets up on the Pi; these are the defaults, so leave this out unless yours is elsewhere. username and password are only needed if Mosquitto asks for them. "lights": false turns the Lights widget off.
_roommate_games: Optional. How the Roommate Cup sends each game night's games. 'email' is any SMTP account (for Gmail, turn on 2-Step Verification and use an App Password). 'sms' is a Twilio account: its Account SID, Auth Token and a Twilio phone number. Set up either, both, or neither. Phone numbers typed without a country code get country_code. Set 'hostname' above so the link in the message works away from home.
_grocery: Optional. The currency grocery prices are in, and the country whose Trader Joe's and Lidl products the search predicts from (USD and united-states unless you say otherwise). 'texts': anyone can sign up in the Grocery app (Texts → Add Your Number, with their carrier) for a free text when someone else adds to the list. They go through the carrier's email-to-text gateway, so they're sent from an email account: put one under texts.email (same fields as roommate_games.email), or leave it out to use the Roommate Cup's. "texts": false turns them off.
_spotify: Optional. Shows what's playing on one Spotify account. Make an app at developer.spotify.com/dashboard, tick 'Web API', and add the redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/spotify/done (with your port if it isn't 8080). Paste its Client ID here (no secret needed), then tap Connect on the Spotify widget on the board's own screen.
_sports: Optional. The Sports widget follows Arsenal, Tottenham and Chelsea (Premier League, FA Cup, League Cup, Champions League), Maryland soccer in the Big Ten, and every Champions League match, from ESPN and bigten.org (no account needed). 'maryland' is "men" (the default) or "women". Match pages also get the referee's record, predicted line-ups, injuries, player ratings and stats from FotMob; 'fotmob': false leaves that out. "sports": false turns it all off.
_calendars: Read-only, and needs no account: each calendar's 'Secret address in iCal format'. Use these instead of (or as well as) the Google account above.
